reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but rewrites the skip-weekend dispatch (daily -> drop weekend, otherwise -> move) that getUpcomingDates and getNextDate already encode inline instead of extracting a shared helper.

duplication.why: The weekend-handling branch (skipWeekend + frequency==='daily' filter vs getDateWithSkippedWeekend map) is a third copy of the logic in getUpcomingDates and getNextDate; the RSchedule construction is also repeated from getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler sits in server/schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates and is registered in SchedulesHandlers and app.method like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its type registration and two focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Readable and correct-looking, but a future change to weekend rules would now have to be made in three places, and the date parsing with T12:00/T00:00 strings is ad hoc rather than using monthUtils parsing.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction for the full weekend dispatch exists to bypass; the move itself goes through getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange: the getUpcomingDates ternary (skipsDailyWeekend ? filter(!isWeekend) : skipWeekend ? map(getDateWithSkippedWeekend) : dates) is reshaped into a flatMap with early returns.
